title: Plane Mirror & Periscope
guideExplore: Switch plane mirror vs periscope — see how mirrors redirect light.
guidePlane: Plane mirror: object and virtual image are equal distances from the mirror.
guidePeriscope: Periscope: two 45° mirrors bend light so you can see over obstacles.
conditionsHint: A plane mirror forms a virtual image the same distance behind the mirror.
quizWrong: Real — in front of the mirror
learnMore: Plane mirrors form upright virtual images. Periscopes use two mirrors at 45° to see around corners.
